_meta.purpose: First-week seed for civic_reports table. One genuine, news-sourced civic issue per district. Loaded by scripts/seed-civic-reports.js once Supabase is provisioned.
rules: Every entry must cite a real West Bengal news report (URL in the description).
description ≤ 500 chars and includes the source URL in plain text.
submitted_at is ISO-8601 — keep dates within the last 90 days so 'time ago' renders sensibly.
Statuses: 'pending' for unresolved, 'reviewed' if administration has formally responded, 'resolved' only with proof.

reports.description: Residents in Falta block report seasonal water-logging on the Diamond Harbour–Falta state-road shoulder; coverage in The Telegraph (2026) flagged delays in stormwater drain construction. Source: telegraphindia.com

Bhabanipur–Hazra crossing has had unrepaired potholes since the pre-monsoon rains, per Times of India city pages (2026). Cabinet-level constituency, so visibility is high. Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com
Frequent load-shedding reported across Darjeeling town through May 2026; Hindustan Times covered grid-balancing issues post-summer demand spike. Source: hindustantimes.com
